posts.author: Kabir_B
posts.text: Rentomojo IPO should apply or avoid? — GMP is one thing, but I’m still not too sure about the business post-listing. I’ve personally been using Rentomojo for almost 3 years and the model does make sense, especially for people who keep moving cities or young people just starting out. I’m only trying my luck with one lot this time and then I’ll see how the price settles before deciding if I want to invest more…

posts.author: Anish_Rajput
posts.text: Rentomojo IPO should apply or avoid? — Too many Ipo’s are lined up , due to which gmp of good IPOs has suffered a bit , but dont know, if market are not bullish that gmp will erode like anything and listing will be around flat or very minimal profit

posts.author: Gagan_suryaputra
posts.text: Rentomojo IPO should apply or avoid? — Good Business to watch, but I wouldn’t chase it just because the grey market is excited.

posts.author: Rohith_Raj
posts.text: Rentomojo IPO should apply or avoid? — I’d probably apply, but mainly with a short-term listing gain in mind rather than as a long-term investment. The demand and GMP look positive, but since a large part of the IPO is existing investors selling their shares, the listing-day movement can be unpredictable. I’d also look at the final subscription and valuation before deciding. For me, a good business and good GMP are not enough the*price you’re buying at matters too, especially for the long term.

posts.author: RupeeRiser
posts.text: Rentomojo IPO should apply or avoid? — IPOs that get laughed at typically beat public sentiment and outperform their perceived risk.

posts.author: JuhiMahiwal
posts.text: Rentomojo IPO should apply or avoid? — Market’s is below 23500, but Rentomojo IPO interest is still picking up. Maybe people just like the business model… or everyone’s finally trying to recover the rent they’ve been paying all these years. A big chunk of the issue is OFS Rs1,105 Cr out of Rs 1,255 Cr is existing investors cashing out. Demand looks good, GMP looks good… but listing day?. Would you apply for this for long term, listing gains, short term or stay away?
